2610.12355.title: Distilling Routed 3D Privilege for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
2610.12355.paper_summary: Spatial reasoning remains a persistent weakness of vision-language models (VLMs), because RGB inputs do not directly provide geometric evidence. Existing remedies either inject 3D into the model at inference, paying architecture and latency costs, or train with outcome rewards that supervise only the final answer. Spatial errors originate in perception: a misjudged depth or direction can be corrected only by the scene's true geometry, which the 3D-scanned sources of spatial training corpora already provide. We propose GPD (Geometry-Privileged Distillation), which makes geometric evidence the privilege in on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). For each question, depth, semantic, and bird's-eye-view (BEV) cues are rendered as compact text and routed to the teacher alongside the reference answer; a privileged KL, applied only to incorrect trajectories, augments GRPO, and the deployed model remains RGB-only. On the 4B backbone, GPD achieves 57.1 on VSI-Bench and 37.6 average across MindCube, SPARBench, MMSI-Bench, and ViewSpatial, outperforming both GRPO and answer-privileged OPSD across spatial reasoning benchmarks. Ablations confirm the complementarity of 3D and answer privilege, the advantage of question-conditioned routing over full-context injection, and the benefit of restricting distillation to incorrect trajectories.
2610.12355.paper_summary_zh: 空間推理仍然是視覺-語言模型（VLMs）的一個持續弱點，因為 RGB 輸入並未直接提供幾何證據。現有的解決方案要麼在推理時將 3D 注入模型，付出架構和延遲的成本，要麼使用僅監督最終答案的結果獎勵進行訓練。空間錯誤源於感知：錯誤判斷的深度或方向只能通過場景的真實幾何來修正，而 3D 掃描的空間訓練語料庫已經提供了這些幾何信息。我們提出了 GPD（幾何特權蒸餾），使幾何證據成為在政策自蒸餾（OPSD）中的特權。對於每個問題，深度、語義和鳥瞰圖（BEV）線索被渲染為緊湊的文本並與參考答案一起路由到教師；一個僅應用於不正確軌跡的特權 KL 增強了 GRPO，且部署的模型仍然僅為 RGB。在 4B 主幹上，GPD 在 VSI-Bench 上達到 57.1，並在 MindCube、SPARBench、MMSI-Bench 和 ViewSpatial 上平均達到 37.6，超越了 GRPO 和答案特權 OPSD 在空間推理基準中的表現。消融實驗確認了 3D 和答案特權的互補性、問題條件路由相對於全上下文注入的優勢，以及將蒸餾限制在不正確軌跡上的好處。
